Static evidence:
- `AstValidator.validateObjectLitGetKey(...)` requires the child of a `GET` object-literal key to be a `FUNCTION` expression.
- The exception says that child became a `CALL`: `Expected function but was call`.
- `GetterReducer.reduce(...)` rewrites matching function expressions into a helper `CALL` via `buildCallNode(...)`.
- `isReduceableFunctionExpression(...)` is too broad: it only checks `NodeUtil.isFunctionExpression(n)`, so accessor functions inside object literal getters are treated like ordinary reducible function expressions.
- In the failing test, each `get nameX(){ return this._name; }` matches `getGetPropertyName(...)`, so the reducer can replace the getter body function with a `CALL`, which produces the exact invalid AST shape that `AstValidator` reports.

- `com.google.javascript.jscomp.FunctionRewriter.SetterReducer.reduce(com.google.javascript.rhino.Node)` appears to have the same structural problem for object literal `SET` accessors, because it uses the same reducibility check and also rewrites to a `CALL`.
